37
Apam Adaka no yɛ
(Eksodɔs 25.10-22)
1 # Eks 25.10-22 Na Besalel de okuo yɛɛ adaka no, ne tentene bɛyɛ basafa baako ne fa, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa, na ne sorokɔ bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa. 2Na ɔde sika amapa duraa emu ne ɛho, na ɔyɛɛ sika hankra twaa ho hyiae. 3Na ɔguu ɛho sika nkaa nnan de tuatuaa ne nan nnan no ho, nkaa mmienu wɔ ɔfa ha, na nkaa mmienu wɔ ɔfa ha. 4Na ɔde okuo senee mpoma, na ɔde sika duraduraa ho. 5Na ɔde mpoma no wurawuraa nkaa no mu, adaka no nkyɛn mu, na wɔde asoa adaka no.
6Na ɔde sika amapa yɛɛ mpata adwa no, ne tentene bɛyɛ basafa baako ne fa, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa. 7Na ɔde sika a wɔaborɔ yɛɛ sika kerubim mmienu maa no firi mpata adwa no tiri mmienu no mu. 8Ɔyɛɛ kerub baako wɔ etire ha, na ɔyɛɛ kerub baako nso wɔ etire ha; mpata adwa no mu na ɔmaa kerubim no firii ne tiri mmienu no soɔ. 9Na kerubim no trɛtrɛɛ wɔn ntaban mu ɔsoro de wɔn ntaban no kataa mpata adwa no so, na wɔn ani kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho; na wɔn anim kyerɛkyerɛ mpata adwa no so.
Wɔyɛ ɛpono no
(Eksodɔs 25.23-30)
10 # Eks 25.23-29 Na ɔde okuo yɛɛ ɛpono no, ne tentene basafa baako, ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ anammɔn baako ne fa, na ne sorokɔ bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa. 11Na ɔde sika amapa duraa ho, na ɔyɛɛ ɛho sika hankra hyiae. 12Na ɔyɛɛ ɛho mfemfamho a ne tɛtrɛtɛ te sɛ nsam hyiae, na ɔyɛɛ mfemfamho no ho sika hankra hyiae. 13Na ɔguu ɛho sika nkaa nnan, na ɔde nkaa no sisii ntwea nnan a ɛwɔ ne nan nnan ho no so. 14Mfemfamho no ase pa ara na nkaa a ɛyɛ mpoma a wɔde bɛsoa ɛpono no wurabea no wɔ. 15Na ɔde okuo senee mpoma no, na ɔde sika duraduraa ho, na wɔde asoa ɛpono no. 16Na ɔde sika amapa yɛɛ ɛpono no so nnoɔma, ne nyowa ne ne nyowaa ne ne nkuruwa ne ne nkoraa a wɔde bɛhwie.
Kaneadua no yɛ
(Eksodɔs 25.31-40)
17 # Eks 25.31-39 Na ɔde sika amapa a wɔaboro na wɔde yɛɛ kaneadua no, ne nan ne ne dua; ɛho kuruwa, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren firi ɛno ara mu. 18Na nsa nsia tuatua ho, kaneadua no nsa mmiɛnsa tuatua ɔfa ha, na kaneadua no nsa mmiɛnsa tuatua ɔfa ha. 19Nkuruwa mmiɛnsa a ɛte sɛ sorɔno deɛ wɔ nsa baako ho, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren, na nkuruwa mmiɛnsa a ɛte sɛ sorɔno deɛ wɔ nsa baako ho, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren: Saa ara na ɛteɛ wɔ nsa nsia a ɛtuatua kaneadua no ho no ho. 20Na kaneadua no ho nkuruwa a ɛte sɛ sorɔno deɛ no yɛ nnan, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren; 21na kukuduuduu no wowɔ nsa mmienu mmienu a ɛtuatua ho no ase, nsa nsia a ɛtuatua ho no ase. 22Ne kukuduuduu ne ne nsa no tua ho ara, ne nyinaa yɛ sika amapa a wɔaborɔ bafua. 23Na ɔde sika amapa yɛɛ ɛso nkanea nson no ne ɛho adaban ne ɛho nso nkukuwa. 24Sika amapa dwetikɛseɛ baako na ɔde yɛeɛ ɛne ɛho nnoɔma no nyinaa.
Wɔyɛ aduhwamhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no
(Eksodɔs 30.1-5)
25 # Eks 30.1-5 Na ɔde okuo yɛɛ aduhwamhyeɛ no afɔrebukyia, ne tentene yɛ anammɔn baako ne fa, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ nso bɛyɛ anammɔn baako ne fa, ɛyɛ ahinanan, ne sorokɔ yɛ basafa baako; ne mmɛn nso tuatua ho ara. 26Na ɔde sika amapa duraa ho, ɛso ne ɛho hyiae, ne ne mmɛn no; na ɔyɛɛ ɛho sika hankra hyiae. 27Na ɔyɛɛ ɛho sika nkaa mmienu, wɔ ne hankra no ase, ne nkyɛn mu mmienu no so, sɛ ɛnyɛ mpoma no wurabea na wɔde asoa. 28Na ɔde okuo senee mpoma, na ɔde sika duraduraa ho.
Sra ngo ne Aduhwam no yɛ
(Eksodɔs 30.22-38)
29 # Eks 30.25, 35 Na ɔyɛɛ sra ngo kronkron ne ɛhyeɛ aduhwam korɔgyenn no, sɛdeɛ odufrafoɔ fra no.

Na Besalel de okuo yɛɛ adaka no, ne tentene bɛyɛ basafa baako ne fa, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa, na ne sorokɔ bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa. Na ɔde sika amapa duraa emu ne ɛho, na ɔyɛɛ sika hankra twaa ho hyiae. Na ɔguu ɛho sika nkaa nnan de tuatuaa ne nan nnan no ho, nkaa mmienu wɔ ɔfa ha, na nkaa mmienu wɔ ɔfa ha. Na ɔde okuo senee mpoma, na ɔde sika duraduraa ho. Na ɔde mpoma no wurawuraa nkaa no mu, adaka no nkyɛn mu, na wɔde asoa adaka no.
Na ɔde sika amapa yɛɛ mpata adwa no, ne tentene bɛyɛ basafa baako ne fa, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa. Na ɔde sika a wɔaborɔ yɛɛ sika kerubim mmienu maa no firi mpata adwa no tiri mmienu no mu. Ɔyɛɛ kerub baako wɔ etire ha, na ɔyɛɛ kerub baako nso wɔ etire ha; mpata adwa no mu na ɔmaa kerubim no firii ne tiri mmienu no soɔ. Na kerubim no trɛtrɛɛ wɔn ntaban mu ɔsoro de wɔn ntaban no kataa mpata adwa no so, na wɔn ani kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho; na wɔn anim kyerɛkyerɛ mpata adwa no so.


Na ɔde okuo yɛɛ ɛpono no, ne tentene basafa baako, ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ anammɔn baako ne fa, na ne sorokɔ bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa. Na ɔde sika amapa duraa ho, na ɔyɛɛ ɛho sika hankra hyiae. Na ɔyɛɛ ɛho mfemfamho a ne tɛtrɛtɛ te sɛ nsam hyiae, na ɔyɛɛ mfemfamho no ho sika hankra hyiae. Na ɔguu ɛho sika nkaa nnan, na ɔde nkaa no sisii ntwea nnan a ɛwɔ ne nan nnan ho no so. Mfemfamho no ase pa ara na nkaa a ɛyɛ mpoma a wɔde bɛsoa ɛpono no wurabea no wɔ. Na ɔde okuo senee mpoma no, na ɔde sika duraduraa ho, na wɔde asoa ɛpono no. Na ɔde sika amapa yɛɛ ɛpono no so nnoɔma, ne nyowa ne ne nyowaa ne ne nkuruwa ne ne nkoraa a wɔde bɛhwie.


Na ɔde sika amapa a wɔaboro na wɔde yɛɛ kaneadua no, ne nan ne ne dua; ɛho kuruwa, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren firi ɛno ara mu. Na nsa nsia tuatua ho, kaneadua no nsa mmiɛnsa tuatua ɔfa ha, na kaneadua no nsa mmiɛnsa tuatua ɔfa ha. Nkuruwa mmiɛnsa a ɛte sɛ sorɔno deɛ wɔ nsa baako ho, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren, na nkuruwa mmiɛnsa a ɛte sɛ sorɔno deɛ wɔ nsa baako ho, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren: Saa ara na ɛteɛ wɔ nsa nsia a ɛtuatua kaneadua no ho no ho. Na kaneadua no ho nkuruwa a ɛte sɛ sorɔno deɛ no yɛ nnan, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren; na kukuduuduu no wowɔ nsa mmienu mmienu a ɛtuatua ho no ase, nsa nsia a ɛtuatua ho no ase. Ne kukuduuduu ne ne nsa no tua ho ara, ne nyinaa yɛ sika amapa a wɔaborɔ bafua. Na ɔde sika amapa yɛɛ ɛso nkanea nson no ne ɛho adaban ne ɛho nso nkukuwa. Sika amapa dwetikɛseɛ baako na ɔde yɛeɛ ɛne ɛho nnoɔma no nyinaa.


Na ɔde okuo yɛɛ aduhwamhyeɛ no afɔrebukyia, ne tentene yɛ anammɔn baako ne fa, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ nso bɛyɛ anammɔn baako ne fa, ɛyɛ ahinanan, ne sorokɔ yɛ basafa baako; ne mmɛn nso tuatua ho ara. Na ɔde sika amapa duraa ho, ɛso ne ɛho hyiae, ne ne mmɛn no; na ɔyɛɛ ɛho sika hankra hyiae. Na ɔyɛɛ ɛho sika nkaa mmienu, wɔ ne hankra no ase, ne nkyɛn mu mmienu no so, sɛ ɛnyɛ mpoma no wurabea na wɔde asoa. Na ɔde okuo senee mpoma, na ɔde sika duraduraa ho.


Na ɔyɛɛ sra ngo kronkron ne ɛhyeɛ aduhwam korɔgyenn no, sɛdeɛ odufrafoɔ fra no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
